scientific_integrity: Classical Tits product, existing ordered-tree sequences, and prior face-algebra results are credited. Finite checks are distinguished from the universal proof. Publication priority is not certified.
scientific_limitations: The numeric commuting-tuple counts and their asymptotic are already implied by the generalized rooted-tree formula documented for OEIS A050352. This finding asserts only the concrete semigroup commuting interpretation and graph structural classification; broader left-regular-band literature may contain an equivalent structural theorem. The graph contains all faces, including the identity. No independent audit performed.
title: Complete commuting-clique geometry of the braid face monoid
